messages.author: 15b83800b6e91096
messages.subject: multilevel CFA with ordinal indicators
parts:
Hi all,

I'm working on a measurement invariance study (following Svetina et al., 2020 approach), but I want to consider the nestedness of my data as well. Measurement invariance is for two groups of patients - those from United States and International Students in the United States. These participants are nested by center where they received psychological services (over 75 centers). In total, we have 9,498 patients (5,230 in group 1, and 4,268 in group 2).

I am incredibly lost with regards to accounting for nestedness in the factor model of the scale we're using (which includes only ordinal items, hence following Svetina et al's measurement invariance example).

I'm wondering if anybody can direct towards resource, or perhaps provide example code, for (a) accounting for nestedness/a cluster variable in CFA using lavaan and (b) how that is taken into consideration for ordinal measurement invariance would be helpful. Thanks.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: multilevel CFA with ordinal indicators
parts:
You cannot (currently) account for nestedness and coarseness in lavaan.  You can keep track of updates by checking the GitHub issue:

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues/225
